Q032-03.notes: Need 2x-3 <= y <= -x+9, so 2x-3 <= -x+9, x <= 4; at x=4, y=5 works.

Q032-04.notes: Slope = 10/2 = 5; f(8)-f(5) = 3*5 = 15. Distractors 20/25/30 correspond to wrong interval counts.

Q032-05.notes: c=4: 0x=0, infinitely many. c=-4: -8x=0, one solution x=0. Other c: x=c+4, one solution.

Q032-08.notes: (0-2a)/(3a-a) = -2a/2a = -1. Distractors from inverted ratio or using 2a as slope.

Q032-09.notes: No solution: a/3 = 4/a, a^2 = 12, a = 2sqrt3 (positive). Check 4/a = 2/sqrt3 ~1.155 != 9/6 = 1.5, so parallel not coincident. Other choices give intersecting lines.
